description: Codex's plans (written from codex-acp 2.2.2 source until G8a's recordings replace it): one turn with the checklist plan as a standard plan update, sent whatever the client advertises, then the plan updated, then a proposed plan as markdown plan_update; answered 'Planned.' and end_turn

note: turn/plan/updated becomes a standard plan update with every step, priority medium and inProgress as in_progress (dist/index.js:31324-31326, updatePlan at :31712-31723); no client capability gates it.
The same plan with its first step done: the whole list again (dist/index.js:31712-31723).

A proposed plan (a plan item's text) goes as a markdown plan_update to a client that advertises plan (dist/index.js:29738-29748, planUpdates at :39794), as Clauseo does; acp warns and shows nothing of it.
